Here is the important information about your stay with us:

Building Name: Shams1

Apartment no.: 4301 on 43rd floor

Wi-Fi password: famliving

Garbage room: It's located inside the service lobby near the elevator.

Main building door: Use the intercom and call reception; they will open the door

And please register your family at the reception for a smooth check-in at the P level

Parking no: 85,86 Ground floor

The reception, gym, pool, and supermarket are located on the P level.

Please note that we are only available every day from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, in case any emergency kindly reach to the reception
